subject: delta(client): WF re-export the capability authority rule, type the authority reply byte cap and add a bounded node balance read
note: The node-wallet entry re-exports the token module's existing authorityLabel rule as capabilityAuthorityLabel, unchanged, so the seller kit admits a capability authority by the client's rule. An authority reply over the 4 MiB byte limit now refuses authority_reply_too_large with the byte-limit OutboundError, which carries code response_byte_limit, as cause; the decoded list limit and other errors are unchanged. readNodeAddressBalance, in its own module and re-exported by the node-wallet entry, reads one exact OS balance over an owner's own connection within 65,536 bytes and 10,000 ms and signs nothing. No core file changes, so HOLD.json is not re-pinned.
